items.author: Techdamentals
items.text: $CSCO reported earnings on Thursday, November 12, 2026, after the close. Adjusted earnings per share were $1.40, above the $1.32 to $1.33 analysts expected. The stock fell 6.24% on Friday, November 13, 2026, while the S&P 500 fell 0.4%. A beat, and the stock still fell. The headline numbers don't tell you why. The filing might: what the company actually filed, lined up against what analysts expect
